query: select from companies where domain in (kaiserpermanente.org, marshmclennan.com, mercer.com, commonspirit.org) and company_size = '10,001+'

findings.kaiserpermanente.org: Only two placeholder pages, 'Kaiser Permanente-US' and 'Kaiser Permanente-LA': type Partnership, industry 'Blockchain Services', no employee count. The operating Kaiser Permanente entity does not resolve by domain.
findings.marshmclennan.com: Resolves to 'Celedinas Insurance Group' (31 employees, Palm Beach Gardens FL), whose description is Marsh McLennan boilerplate. Wrong company, silently.
findings.mercer.com: Regional pages only: Mercer UK (270), Mercer Latinoamerica (125), Mercer Sverige (23). Global Mercer does not resolve. Two more Mercer regions sit on marsh.com instead.
findings.commonspirit.org: Still no parent entity. The size-filtered query (size band 10,001+) surfaced 6 more member hospitals on top of the 4 already seen: Harrison 750, Longmont 448, Holy Cross Jordan Valley 334, Davis 308, Salt Lake 198, Mountain Point 114 employees, all tagged '10,001+'.
